title: Minkowski’s conjecture on Euclidean minima of totally real number fields

\[
M(K)=\sup_{x\in K}\inf_{c\in\mathcal{O}_K}N(x-c),
\]
where $N$ is the absolute value of the norm map, one has
\[
M(K)\le 2^{-n}\sqrt{d_K}.
\]

title: Computing zeta functions of low genus curves in average polynomial time
statement:
Let $X/\mathbb{Q}$ be a smooth projective curve of genus $g$, and let $X_p/\mathbb{F}_p$ denote its reduction modulo a prime $p$. For every prime $p$ of good reduction, define $L_p(T)$ by
\[
Z(X_p;T)=\exp\left(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\frac{\#X_p(\mathbb{F}_{p^n})T^n}{n}\right)=\frac{L_p(T)}{(1-T)(1-pT)}.
\]
Given a bound $N$, compute $L_p(T)$ for all primes $p\le N$ of good reduction for $X$.

\]
